$description: SajdaTime motion tokens, release 1.6. Tested against app/src/main/java/com/sajdatime/app/ui/theme/Motion.kt by DesignTokensTest. Pick by what moves, never by mood. DesignRulesTest bans a written tween, spring or infinite animation anywhere else.

quick.usage: An icon or arrow swaps or turns (the bell, fold chevrons). Also the exit of a Standard or Quick enter.

standard.usage: A shape, colour, position or block of text changes in place (the tick, theme thumb, pause row, Now and Next, Qibla aligned state).

draw.usage: A drawing runs across the screen (rings, sky, day path). Nothing in the app is longer.

qiblaDialFollow.usage: The Qibla dial follows the compass; input driven, the one written tween outside Motion.kt.

qiblaArrivalBuzz.usage: One vibration through Vibrator (media usage) when the phone first points within 5 degrees of the Qibla.

rules: Exits use the token one step shorter than the enter; reversing an animation counts as an exit.
No entrance animation. Things move only when the user touched them, a sensor changed, or a real event happened. One exception: the day path draws in once per app open.
Never animated: prayer times, countdown digits, notice text, the disclaimer, the city title and Hijri date, the glass bar's position, dialog or sheet text.
Letters never move or morph on their own (breaks Arabic and Urdu joining). A whole block of text may fade.

Respect the system's reduce motion setting. Android: Compose animations follow the system animator duration scale; never bypass it with a hand written loop. iOS: read accessibilityReduceMotion and replace movement with a fade or no animation.
